claims.subject: relationship--apt17--mitre--62d2acec0cc37553
claims.statement: APT17 related-to Winnti Group: The group has heavily targeted the gaming industry, but it has also expanded the scope of its targeting.(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti June 2015)(Citation: Novetta Winnti April 2015) Some reporting suggests a number of other groups, including [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001), [APT17](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0025), and [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004), are closely linked to [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044).(Citation: 401 TRG Winnti Umbrella May 2018)
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=partially-supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
